answer_options.label: Secure
answer_options.definition: Protect an acute vulnerability. The answer may be domestic capacity, trusted allied supply, stockpiles, substitution or redundancy, not necessarily self-sufficiency.

answer_options.label: Preserve
answer_options.definition: Keep and strengthen a capability the country already does well and that still has strategic value.

answer_options.label: Partner
answer_options.definition: The capability matters, but duplicating it at home is not the best answer. Rely on trusted partners or diversified supply, and make that reliance durable.

answer_options.label: Accelerate
answer_options.definition: Deploy a technology faster because the domestic energy system needs more of it. It says nothing about making the equipment at home.

answer_options.label: Watch
answer_options.definition: Do not make domestic production a major policy priority. Keep access affordable and diversified, and watch for changes in risk or opportunity.

answer_options.label: I don't know / outside my expertise
